summary: Composes a 4x4 transformation matrix in a1 (8 __m64 slots) from a scale value a2, an optional rotation matrix a4, an optional origin matrix a3 and an optional additive translation a5. First seeds a1 with a diagonal scale matrix (a2 at this+0x0, this+0x10 high cell and this+0x28; this+0x38 homogeneous 1.0/1.0 from a SIMD constant). When a4 is non-null, computes the 3x3 adjugate/inverse of the rotation in stack __m64 locals and multiplies it into the scale-seeded a1 (translating by a3 first when it is non-null, then re-adding it). When a5 is non-null, adds its translation into the last row. Exits 3DNow mode and returns a1.

local_names.a1: output 4x4 transformation matrix as an array of 8 __m64 values
local_names.a2: scale value packed into the diagonal of the output matrix
local_names.a3: optional translation/origin matrix; when non-null it is subtracted, multiplied, then re-added
local_names.a4: optional rotation matrix whose 3x3 adjugate/inverse is folded into the output
local_names.a5: optional additive translation matrix applied to the last row
local_names.v6: a2 promoted to an __m64 for the diagonal seeding
local_names.v118..v124: stack __m64 locals holding the inverse rotation matrix components used for the multiply

operations.description: Seed a1 with a diagonal scale matrix: this+0x0 = a2, this+0x8 = 0, this+0x10 low cell = 0 with high cell = a2, this+0x18 = 0, this+0x20 = 0, this+0x28 = a2, this+0x30 = 0, this+0x38 = 0x3F80000000000000LL (homogeneous 1.0/1.0 from the SIMD constant global)
When a4 (rotation matrix) is non-null, enter the rotation composition path

Compute the 3x3 adjugate/inverse of the a4 rotation using 3DNow pfadd/pfmul/pfacc/pfsub and the angle constants from the SIMD constant global, packing the resulting rotation components into the stack __m64 locals (v118..v124)
Nested: when a3 (translation/origin matrix) is non-null, subtract a3 from the last row of a1 (this+0x30, this+0x38) before the rotation multiply
Multiply the inverse rotation into the scale-seeded matrix, writing the composed 3x3 result back into this+0x0 through this+0x28
In the a3 (translation) case, re-add a3 to the last row (this+0x30, this+0x38) so the origin is restored after the rotation
When a5 (additive translation) is non-null, add a5's translation into the last row: this+0x30 += a5 low, this+0x38 low cell += a5 high low cell
Return a1, the fully composed 4x4 transformation matrix
